parts.text: What is the immediate field recovery protocol when a cashier encounters an ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze, and how do we ensure the customer is not double-charged?

eval_cases.context: Certified Hardware Runbook: Toshiba TCx 810 POS Hardware, Diagnostics & Service Guide. Equipment Covered: Toshiba TCx 810 (TGCS Machine Type 6201: xxC, xx3, xx5, xx7). Documentation Source: [Toshiba_TCx_810_Guide.pdf](https://storage.cloud.google.com/maki-ki-agentic-da-me-module1-bucket/store_pos_manual_generic/Toshiba_TCx_810_Guide.pdf). ERR-PAY-4001 Toshiba TCx 810 Pinpad EMV PIN Pad Tokenization Timeout CRITICAL (Payment). The immediate field recovery protocol and steps to prevent double-charging are: Step 1: Do NOT re-swipe or charge customer card again. This is the primary step to prevent a double-charge. Step 2: Hold Yellow + # on payment PIN pad for 3s to reboot payment module. Step 3: Check 12V PoweredUSB cable connection in rear I/O channel of the Toshiba TCx 810. Step 4: Open Manager Menu and navigate to Journal Audit Slip on Toshiba TCx 810. Step 5: If status shows AUTHORIZED_UNSETTLED, print receipt slip. If status shows VOIDED_ERROR, the transaction did not go through and further action is required.

parts.text: The immediate field recovery protocol for ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze on Toshiba TCx 810 Pinpad: 1. Do NOT re-swipe or charge customer card again to prevent double-charging. 2. Hold Yellow + # on payment PIN pad for 3s to reboot payment module. 3. Check 12V PoweredUSB cable connection in rear I/O channel. 4. Open Manager Menu -> Journal Audit Slip on Toshiba TCx 810. If status shows AUTHORIZED_UNSETTLED, print receipt slip. If status shows VOIDED_ERROR, the transaction did not go through. Documentation: [Toshiba_TCx_810_Guide.pdf](https://storage.cloud.google.com/maki-ki-agentic-da-me-module1-bucket/store_pos_manual_generic/Toshiba_TCx_810_Guide.pdf).
